title: It really Works !!!!!!!
text: It really Works !!!!!!!. It's light and can be moved from room to room. You don't hear a thing. The filter cleans beautifully , I personally like fantastick, so wear a mask. I spray it on and watch it melt off all pollutants that grab onto the steel rod filter. Wipe it clean. Also, There is a filter that looks like it belongs on the end of a blow dryer as you open the lid, it's right there. t's round and pops out, This too must be cleaned and pat dry with paper towels. I actually own 2 of these, and they do work wonders !!!!
